period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2017 (Unaudited)"), downloaded directly from the bank's live financial-statements archive (legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements), not Wayback Machine. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2017' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the first quarter ended 31 March 2017') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 236,824,785,557 + Shareholders' equity 27,064,243,404 = Total assets 263,889,028,961 exactly; Net interest income 1,552,460,137 + Investment income 527,063,079 + Commission 544,984,025 + Other operating income 332,271,398 = Total operating income 2,956,778,639 exactly. Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1 (identical to a discrete quarter for Q1 specifically). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.
